title: Nilo-Saharan Languages - SourceWatch
text: Nilo-Saharan Languages are a family of 205 languages. The most common are Dholuo in Kenya and Kanuri in Nigeria with 3.5 million speakers each. The next largest, measured by number of speakers are: Kalenjin; Dinka, Lugbara; Lango; Maa; Acholi; Lendu; Ngambay...
